thumbs

components · 0.3.0 · v4 round 10 · aj-c-thumbs

Helpful and Not helpful on something the journal wrote: an answer in Ask, a note on Today, the Day page or a Reflections leaf. One at a time; the thumbs down asks "What was wrong?" (rateform) before it fills red. In Ask's tools it draws no box; in a note's foot it is a small row of its own.

Default

Helpful and Not helpful, neither set.

Helpful

The thumbs up set: filled --rate-up.

Not helpful

A sent thumbs down: filled --rate-down. Pressed again it returns to none; then it asks again.

Hover

Each thumb’s hover in its own colour.

Focus

A thumb takes the product’s ring.

Asking why

The thumbs down pressed: its form open under the row, from its start, the thumb expanded.

Pair

A note’s foot: a small row of its own, the thumbs --s1 apart.

Pair asking

The pair’s form floats from the start of the row that holds it.

Long

Stress test only: long names.

Non-Latin

Stress test only: Japanese names.
